FORMS.TITLE: Forms

CHECKLIST.IDENTITY: Give the form a name and address
CHECKLIST.QUESTIONS: Review questions, labels and answer options
CHECKLIST.PUBLIC_CONTACT_MAPPING: Map name and phone or email to receive responses

BUILDER.EMPTY_SECTION: Add a question to start this section.
BUILDER.NO_FIELD_SELECTED: Select a question in the structure or preview to edit it.
BUILDER.QUESTION: Question
BUILDER.OPTIONS_HINT: Separate each option with a comma.
BUILDER.ADD_QUESTION_DESCRIPTION: Choose the format a person will see when completing the form.

EMPTY.TEMPLATES_DESCRIPTION: Start with a short lead capture or pre-consultation journey.
EMPTY.SUBMISSIONS_DESCRIPTION: Responses from public links and invitations will appear here.

NEW_DIALOG.TITLE: Create form
NEW_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: You can define fields, CRM destination, and publishing next.
NEW_DIALOG.NAME: Form name
NEW_DIALOG.STARTER_HINT: You can change every question, text, and destination afterwards.

PRE_CONSULTATION.TITLE: Pre-consultation
PRE_CONSULTATION.REASON: Briefly tell us why you need an appointment
PRE_CONSULTATION.PREFERRED_PERIOD: Which time of day usually works best for you?

CLINICAL_INTAKE.TITLE: Clinical intake
CLINICAL_INTAKE.MEDICATIONS: Which medications are you currently taking?
CLINICAL_INTAKE.CONDITIONS: Are there relevant health conditions for this appointment?
CLINICAL_INTAKE.OBSERVATIONS: Is there anything else the care team should know?
CLINICAL_INTAKE.CONSENT: I authorize the processing of this health information exclusively for my care.

FIELDS.NAME: What should we call you?
FIELDS.CONSENT: I authorize contact regarding this request.

FIELD_GROUPS.TITLE: Add question group
FIELD_GROUPS.DESCRIPTION: Start with a ready commercial structure and adjust every question afterwards.
FIELD_GROUPS.SAVE_DESCRIPTION: This group saves only question structure. Responses and patient data are never copied.
FIELD_GROUPS.NAME: Group name
FIELD_GROUPS.DELETE_DESCRIPTION: Delete {name}? Forms already using this group will not change.

CONTACT.TITLE: Contact details
CONTACT.DESCRIPTION: Name, WhatsApp, and email ready to link the contact.
CONTACT.NAME: What should we call you?

APPOINTMENT.TITLE: Appointment preference
APPOINTMENT.DESCRIPTION: A preferred date and time period without creating an appointment.

COMMERCIAL.TITLE: Source and interest
COMMERCIAL.DESCRIPTION: Commercial source and context to qualify the opportunity.
COMMERCIAL.ORIGIN: How did you hear about the clinic?

EDITOR.SENSITIVE_HEALTH_NOTICE: Clinical intake is private: it can only be sent through an individual invitation linked to the patient and never updates CRM data automatically.
EDITOR.CLINICAL_ACCESS: Who can view this clinical intake
EDITOR.CLINICAL_ACCESS_DESCRIPTION: Administrators always have access. Select the professionals or teams allowed to read clinical responses and documents.
EDITOR.CLINICAL_ACCESS_EMPTY_USERS: No professionals are available in this account.
EDITOR.CLINICAL_ACCESS_EMPTY_TEAMS: No teams have been created in this account.
EDITOR.CLINICAL_RETENTION_HINT: Leave empty to avoid automatic data disposal. Set this period with the account's clinical and legal guidance.
EDITOR.BRAND_LOGO_UPLOAD_HINT: PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to 2 MB. The uploaded image takes precedence over the URL above.
EDITOR.OPPORTUNITY_MAPPING_HELP: After choosing the pipeline, compatible fields can receive answers automatically.
EDITOR.POLICY: When an open opportunity already exists
EDITOR.POLICY_REUSE: Reuse the most recent open opportunity
EDITOR.SECTION_DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: Give the respondent context for this step
EDITOR.SIGNATURE_HINT: The respondent types their full name to confirm acceptance. This is not a qualified electronic signature.

VERSIONS.TITLE: Version history
VERSIONS.DESCRIPTION: Every publish preserves the version that received responses.

DUPLICATE.TITLE: Duplicate form
DUPLICATE.DESCRIPTION: The copy keeps questions and mappings, but starts private with no responses or invitations.

INVITATION.TITLE: Send form
INVITATION.DESCRIPTION: The link is tied to this contact and opportunity.
INVITATION.HISTORY_EMPTY: No form has been sent for this opportunity.
INVITATION.EMPTY: Publish a template before sending an invitation.
INVITATION.SENSITIVE_HEALTH_NOTICE: This link is individual, single-use, and should not be forwarded.

ERROR.REQUIRED: Fill in name, identifier, and at least one section.
ERROR.INVALID_CONFIGURATION: Review required fields, selection options, and conditions before publishing.
